Independent uniform coupon streams are an exact construction; a fixed initially seen coupon changes completeness with probability at most 1/m. The Poisson factorial-moment coupon limit proves independent Gumbel completion clocks with shifts theta_i/(k-1). The exponential minimum race gives exact softmax weights. The S log(x)/(N-x) derivative comparison yields deterministic dominance outside the n/log n window. value.rationale: The last discovered part is a natural localization statistic of a random cover tour. Part-size differences on the vanishing relative scale n/log n produce a nondegenerate full probability simplex of winners, while larger gaps force a unique winner. Unlike bipartite alternation, the nonbipartite class visitation rates oppose raw coupon-number advantages and yield the sharp attenuation exponent 1/(k-1). The joint Gumbel limit recovers all simultaneous late-cover probabilities, providing substantive extreme-value structure beyond a routine expected-time calculation.
